title: 第517章 卑鄙的三眼郎
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

吞下龙珠后，三眼真君就感觉到肚子里多出来一股强大无比的治愈能量，这股能量快速地恢复着他断裂的筋脉和损伤的内脏。

不过瞬间功夫，三眼真君的伤势就恢复了。这还不说，他也感觉到自己的境界快速提升，瞬间就从二类渡劫大圆满的境界，提升到了三类渡劫。

一股金光直接冲入天际，在天空炸开，这就是三类渡劫的飞升神力。

再看小龙女，因为失去了龙珠的原因，她的身体也有了大幅度变化。满头的金色长发瞬间变白了，原本细腻白嫩的肌肤也干瘪了下去。很快，她就从一个明眸皓齿的少女，变成了一个白发苍苍、满脸皱纹的老婆婆。

这个也正常。本来小龙女都六十多岁了，是因为龙珠的原因她才青春永驻的。没有了龙珠，她自然恢复到了真实年龄。

“三眼郎？你伤势好了，境界也提升了，太好了。你什么时候和我去成亲？咳……咳……”

看到三眼真君伤势恢复、境界还提升后，小龙女很是开心，拉着三眼真君的胳膊询问道。毕竟刚才三眼真君答应过她。

“呵呵，和你成婚，你配吗？”

哪知道三眼真君冷冷地看着小龙女，嘴里冒出来这段话。

“什么？”

小龙女惊呆了，没想到心上人竟然这么说。难道刚才是心上人骗她的，就是为了骗她的龙珠？

“呵呵，你现在变得又老又丑，让我和你成婚，你做梦吧？我现在不但恢复了伤势，实力大增，我什么样的女人找不到，会找你这老妇人，哈哈。”

三眼真君哈哈大笑起来，笑得很畅快。自然，刚才他就是骗小龙女的。他从来没有爱过小龙女，一直都是在骗对方，刚才也是为了骗小龙女的龙珠。

“你不是人……我救了你，你这么对我？”

小龙女也很是绝望，没想到三眼真君是这种人。不过小龙女因为失去了龙珠，不但变老，法力也没有了。她自然没办法击杀三眼真君，把龙珠抢过来。

“我要告诉我父王，说你骗了我龙珠。”

小龙女用手擦拭了一下眼泪，就站起身来要离开，告诉父王。

“告诉你父王，西海龙王？”

听到小龙女的话，三眼真君心中一凛。要知道西海龙王可是西海的霸主，是三类渡劫大圆满的存在，而且他手下有一群强者。如果小龙女回去把这件事告诉西海龙王，这的确很麻烦。

三眼真君自认为自己的实力没办法和西海龙王相比。

“龙儿，我错了，我刚才和你开玩笑的。我现在就带你走，我们找一个城市成亲。”

他心思一转，立马对小龙女温柔地说道，心里则有了一个歹毒的念头。

“真的？我知道你不会不要我的，呜呜。”

看到三眼真君这么说，小龙女转怒为喜，直接扑到了三眼真君的怀里，大哭起来。

被一个老婆婆扑到怀里，三眼真君快要恶心死了。不过他还是强忍住恶心，笑道：“走吧。”

两人并肩而走。

这里是十万大山的某处山峰，周围都是陡峭的悬崖。在走到一处悬崖的时候，三眼真君眼神一闪。

“龙儿，你看那是什么？”

他快速地走到悬崖峭壁的边缘，从地上捡起来一个东西。

Page (1/3)

After swallowing the dragon ball, the Three-Eyed Lord felt an extremely powerful healing energy in his stomach. This energy quickly restored his broken tendons and damaged internal organs.

However, in an instant, the Three-Eyed Lord recovered from his injuries.Not to mention, he also felt that his realm was rapidly improving, and he was instantly promoted from the second-level realm of transcending tribulations to the third-category realm of transcending tribulations.

A stream of golden light rushed directly into the sky and exploded in the sky. This was the ascending power of the third type of tribulation.

Looking at Little Dragon Girl again, her body has also changed significantly due to the loss of the Dragon Ball.The long golden hair on his head instantly turned white, and the originally delicate and white skin shriveled up.Soon, she changed from a girl with bright eyes and white teeth to an old woman with gray hair and wrinkles on her face.

This is also normal.Originally, Xiao Longnu was over sixty years old, and it was because of the Dragon Balls that she remained young forever.Without the Dragon Balls, she naturally returned to her true age.

"Three-eyed man? Your injuries have healed and your level has improved. That's great. When will you get married to me? Cough... cough..."

After seeing that the Three-Eyed Lord recovered from his injuries and improved his realm, Xiao Longnu was very happy. She pulled the Three-Eyed Lord's arm and asked.After all, the Three-Eyed Lord had promised her just now.

"Haha, are you worthy of marrying you?"

Unexpectedly, the Three-Eyed Lord looked at Xiao Longnu coldly and said these words.

"What?"

Xiao Longnu was shocked, she didn't expect her sweetheart to say that.Could it be that her sweetheart had lied to her just now, just to get her Dragon Ball?

"Haha, you have become old and ugly now. Are you dreaming about asking me to marry you? Not only have I recovered from my injuries, my strength has also greatly increased. What kind of woman can I not find, so I would look for an old woman like you, haha."

The Three-Eyed Lord laughed heartily.Of course, he just lied to Xiao Longnu.He has never loved Xiao Longnu, he has always lied to him, and just now he was trying to deceive Xiao Longnu about the dragon beads.

"You are not human...I saved you, and you treat me like this?"

Xiao Longnu was also very desperate. She didn't expect the Three-Eyed True Lord to be such a person.However, because the little dragon girl lost the dragon ball, not only did she grow old, but her magic power was also gone.Naturally, she couldn't kill the Three-Eyed Lord and snatch the dragon ball.

"I want to tell my father that you lied to me about the Dragon Ball."

Xiao Longnu wiped her tears with her hands, then stood up to leave and tell her father.

"Tell your father, the Dragon King of the West Sea?"

Hearing Xiao Longnu's words, Three-Eyed True Monarch felt a chill in his heart.You must know that the Dragon King of the West Sea is the overlord of the West Sea. He is a three-category tribulation-transcending Great Perfection existence, and he has a group of strong men under him.If Xiao Longnu goes back and tells the Dragon King of the West Sea about this, it will be really troublesome.

The Three-Eyed Lord believes that his strength cannot be compared with the Dragon King of the West Sea.

"Long'er, I was wrong. I was joking with you just now. I will take you away now, and we will find a city to get married."

His mind changed and he immediately spoke to Xiao Longnu gently, with a vicious thought in his mind.

"Really? I know you won't let me go, wuwu."

Seeing what the Three-Eyed Lord said, Xiao Longnu turned from anger to joy, threw herself directly into the Three-Eyed Lord's arms, and burst into tears.

Being thrown into the arms of an old woman, the Three-Eyed Lord was almost sick to death.However, he still suppressed his nausea and said with a smile, "Let's go."

The two walked side by side.

This is a peak somewhere in the Shiwanda Mountains, surrounded by steep cliffs.When he reached a cliff, the Three-Eyed Lord's eyes flashed.

"Long'er, what do you think that is?"

He quickly walked to the edge of the cliff and picked up something from the ground.
